generation.outputHandling: Original PNG bytes, with no crop, scaling, alpha cleanup, recolor or recompression.

sourceImageInspection.groaner-original-sh1.jpg: Original SH1 model inspected; lean four-legged hairless dog with long muzzle, two short ears, pale eye, mottled hide and thin tail. Original model used in both generated poses.
sourceImageInspection.sniffer-male-model.jpg: Original SH4 male inspected; four canine legs, shoulder hump, yellow-green patchy fur, two ear structures and long red tongue. Female earless/red-purple variant not borrowed.
sourceImageInspection.sh4-official-guide-page19.png: Piggyback official guide page inspected for identity and movement context. It shows a Sniffer model and differentiates later female variants; no animation sequence or attack angles are measured.

actionEvidence.adaptation: The short grounded snap and compact jump are authored static presentations for existing versus slots. The guide does not prove those exact poses or distinguish the project’s neutral/forward commands.

actionEvidence.observedAction: Lunging approach and bite; repositioning and stepping back.
actionEvidence.adaptation: One walking step and a compact preparation of the bite translate the existing locomotion and short-bite slot. No male grapple, tongue attack, complete gait cycle or source timing is claimed.

visualReview.observed: One full right-facing body, four paws on staggered supports, jaws open and neck extended. Thin tail, two ears and pale eye retained. The long pursuit pose remains separate.
limits: The head angle and bite compression are authored, not extracted from a source frame.

visualReview.observed: One compact right-facing jumping-bite pose. Both forelegs bent and lifted; two hind legs accounted for. Complete tail, muzzle and claws within the alpha envelope.
limits: A single anticipation/early-leap view. It does not prove a complete jump or its duration.

visualReview.observed: One male with hunched shoulders, yellow-green coat, ears and complete red tongue. Four limbs, one forepaw advanced and lifted, the others staggered. No female features or extra paw.
limits: One walking key pose, not an animated walk cycle.

visualReview.observed: One low male body, jaw open toward the right, hind legs braced and forepaws advanced. Tongue hangs below the jaw and stays complete, without a tongue-projectile effect.
limits: Short-bite presentation is authored from documented biting behavior; no victim or hold shown.

alphaReview.method: Unmodified generated alpha inspected with Pillow and the project’s existing importer.
alphaReview.lowAlphaOutsideEnvelope: Some near-transparent pixels below alpha 32 extend farther than the significant silhouette. No cleanup was applied. Native/background composition and gameplay review remain separate checks.

runtimeReview.note: Input routing, natural recovery, exact static-image selection and native composition passed. This does not certify browser behavior or original animation fidelity.

heldCandidates.robbieShotgun: No generation/import: source model filenames identify Robbie_Rifle.obj while the catalog ID says Shotgun. Exact weapon identity remains unresolved.

limits: Zero newly completed bases or portraits: the remaining source/hold gates are preserved.
Zero animated clips or certified 1:1 assets.
Official/model images establish anatomy; walkthrough text establishes action families. No native action frame sequence or original timing was newly inspected.
Opposite-facing output uses the game’s existing mirror presentation, not an independently sourced opposite anatomy view.

calibrationReview.observation: The lowest whole-image pixel belongs to the long tongue. Paw support, not tongue bottom, is the relevant ground reference. Existing new-frame anchor is approximately 4 source-image pixels above the furthest visible foreclaw, about 0.45 pixels at the inspected game scale.
calibrationReview.sourceMeaning: Coordinates are measured on the generated candidate, not an original-game animation frame.
